raw: Agent Name: Planner, Step Number: 1, Reason for Mistake: Misapplied conservation of mass by claiming some mass is “lost” when oxygen escapes and giving “18 g,” which isn’t an option. The total mass of water + oxygen equals the original 20 g (choice D) because no matter is added or removed; heat doesn’t add mass and gas escaping doesn’t reduce the total produced mass.
